identity.name: Muhammad Ahmad
identity.title: AI Engineer · Agentic AI & Automation · Full-Stack
identity.tagline: Engineering intelligent systems for the next digital era.
identity.bio: I build agentic AI systems and the software they live inside — agents that retrieve, decide and act, wired into automation, web apps and Flutter clients. Based in Lahore, working across the whole stack rather than one slice of it.
identity.bioLong: Around three years of building, finished alongside a BSCS at the University of Central Punjab in 2024. The work moved steadily from applications toward the systems underneath them: retrieval pipelines, tool-calling agents, and workflows that keep running when nobody is watching. I work end to end because products lose their shape in the handoffs — the agent layer, the API, the schema, the interface and the mobile client are one problem, not five. Right now that means building a multi-tenant SaaS solo, with an AI agent at its core.

timeline.title: Building intelligent systems
timeline.text: Continued practice across agentic AI, automation, full-stack web, Flutter mobile, and desktop software.
